test_mapping.source_test: a session CLI highlight paints the range and reveals the deep line

verification: The compiled CLI starts an owned loopback daemon and a real 140-by-24 PTY review of the source's 130-line before/after fixture.
Session list discovers registration; highlight add focuses new line 111, range [13,19), with warning tone. JSON fields, empty stderr and exit status are asserted.
The needle must appear below row zero and above row twelve, and its actual VT cell background must differ from the unmarked token on that row.
Highlight clear reports removedCount 1 and remainingCount 0. Navigate targets new line 25, verifies exact JSON fields and the same near-top screen landing with the old needle absent.
The harness continuously drains terminal output during CLI exchanges, isolates configuration/runtime paths, owns all child cleanup, and explicitly enables truecolor independently of ambient NO_COLOR.
Broader session implementation, cross-platform execution and complete cell-buffer differential parity are separate gates.
